pages.title: Furnace Fuels and Boosts
pages.text: The Crusher and Alloyer use furnace fuels. Thermite Dust gives a 2x processing boost; Ignatius Fuel gives a 3x boost. A faster recipe still needs its complete inputs and enough output space.

A machine will wait when inputs, fuel, or output room are missing. Adding more fuel does not let it produce an item without its required ingredients. Keep a spare output chest nearby to avoid stalled work.
